matthew.8.p1.b1.text: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.

matthew.8.p1.b2.text: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying,

matthew.8.p1.b3.text: Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.

matthew.8.p2.b1.text: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man.

matthew.8.p2.b3.text: And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

matthew.8.p2.b4.text: See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.

matthew.8.p3.b2.text: a centurion came and pleaded with Him,

matthew.8.p3.b3.text: “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”

matthew.8.p3.b4.text: I will go and heal him,

matthew.8.p4.b1.text: Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof.

matthew.8.p4.b2.text: But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

matthew.8.p4.b3.text: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me.

matthew.8.p4.b4.text: I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.

matthew.8.p5.b1.text: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him,

matthew.8.p5.b2.text: Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.

matthew.8.p5.b3.text: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.

matthew.8.p5.b4.text: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

matthew.8.p6.b1.text: Then Jesus said to the centurion,

matthew.8.p6.b2.text: Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.

matthew.8.p6.b3.text: And his servant was healed at that very hour.

matthew.8.p7.b1.text: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.

matthew.8.p7.b2.text: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her,

matthew.8.p7.b3.text: and she got up and began to serve them.

matthew.8.p8.b1.text: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus,

matthew.8.p8.b2.text: and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.

matthew.8.p8.b3.text: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.”

matthew.8.p9.b1.text: Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.

matthew.8.p9.b2.text: Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.

matthew.8.p9.b3.text: Lord, first let me go and bury my father.

matthew.8.p9.b4.text: Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.

matthew.8.p10.b1.text: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.

matthew.8.p10.b2.text: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves;

matthew.8.p10.b4.text: Lord, save us! We are perishing!

matthew.8.p11.b1.text: You of little faith, … why are you so afraid?

matthew.8.p11.b2.text: Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea,

matthew.8.p11.b4.text: What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!

matthew.8.p12.b1.text: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes,

matthew.8.p12.b2.text: He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent

matthew.8.p12.b3.text: that no one could pass that way.

matthew.8.p12.b4.text: What do You want with us, Son of God? … Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?

matthew.8.p13.b1.text: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.

matthew.8.p13.b2.text: If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.

matthew.8.p13.b4.text: So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.

matthew.8.p14.b1.text: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.

matthew.8.p14.b2.text: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus.

matthew.8.p14.b3.text: And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
